Dehydrated Potato Powder Supplier for Food Manufacturers and Export Buyers

Dehydrated potato powder goes into instant mash, soup and gravy bases, snack doughs and breading mixes, where it adds potato flavor and body without the work of fresh potatoes. Tradenest Naturals is a dehydrated potato powder supplier in India for food manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, restaurants and private label brands. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The potatoes are dehydrated and milled to a uniform potato powder 80 mesh that suits both industrial and commercial kitchens. As a dehydrated potato powder exporter, we offer bulk supply, export packaging and private label packing. Send Tradenest Naturals your volume, destination, packaging preference and application, and we will reply with a quotation, the product specification sheet and a sample if you need one.

Product Overview

Dehydrated Potato Powder is a shelf-stable ingredient made by cleaning, preparing, drying, grinding and sieving fresh potatoes into a free-flowing powder. It has a clean potato flavor, a light cream to pale yellow color, and is much easier to handle and store than raw potatoes. Depending on your production layout and recipe design, this powder can be easily reconstituted with water or blended directly into dry formulations. Our standard product is made for food processors who want steady potato flavor, dry-mix convenience, less storage space and simpler stock control. Packaging and private label formats can be matched to your line and market.

Manufacturing and Processing Method

Tradenest Naturals follows controlled processing steps to keep each batch consistent. Raw potatoes are inspected, sorted and cleaned to eliminate soil and foreign material before being cut or prepared for dehydration. Drying is controlled to bring moisture down while keeping the familiar flavor of fresh potatoes. The dried material is then milled, sieved and sealed in moisture-barrier, food-grade packaging.
  • Raw material inspection and careful sorting
  • Thorough cleaning and preparation of fresh potatoes
  • Controlled dehydration for optimal moisture reduction
  • Pulverizing and precision grinding to target fineness
  • Sieving to a uniform 80 mesh
  • Batch inspection, packing, labeling and traceability records
The standard product has no fillers or artificial colors. If a custom formulation needs a processing aid or carrier, it is agreed with you and written into the product specification before production.

Typical Technical Specifications

The values below appear on the product specification sheet shared with every quotation. Color and flavor can vary slightly with the season's raw material. Please approve the specification before confirming a production order.
  • Mesh size: 80 mesh
  • Moisture: ≤ 8%
  • Processing: Dehydrated, milled and sieved
  • Appearance: Fine, free-flowing powder ranging in cream to pale yellow shades
  • Flavor: Characteristic, clean potato flavor accompanied by mild earthy notes
  • Foreign matter: Controlled through raw material inspection and sieving
  • Shelf life: 12 months in sealed packaging
For your technical evaluation, our team can discuss particle size, moisture, allergen status and packaging materials before you order. If you need analytical results for your market, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Applications in Food Manufacturing

Dehydrated potato powder is widely integrated into dry mixes, prepared foods, snack items, bakery goods, and commercial foodservice preparations. It adds potato flavor and solids while making handling, weighing and storage simpler. Depending on the recipe, it can act as a flavoring, a bulking solid, a texture aid or the main ingredient in reconstituted products.
  • Instant soups, sauce bases, gravy mixes, and meal premixes
  • Potato snacks, traditional namkeen, extruded snacks, and savory seasoning blends
  • Bakery products, crisp crackers, biscuits, bread varieties, and specialty dough formulations
  • Ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat convenience potato foods
  • Coating systems, breading mixes, and value-added convenience food formulations
  • Commercial restaurant, hotel, quick-service restaurant (QSR), and cloud-kitchen batch recipes
  • Private-label dry mixes and customized culinary ingredient blends

Buyer Benefits

  • Improved shelf stability: Low moisture profiles allow for extended storage capacity compared to fresh potatoes when properly packaged and warehoused.
  • Reduced logistics complexity: Dry powder formats simplify handling, weight management, transport logistics, and centralized manufacturing storage.
  • Batch convenience: Uniform powder consistency ensures repeatable dosing across industrial recipes and dry-blend production lines.
  • Cost efficiency: Dehydrated ingredients eliminate extensive preparation labor, raw spoilage, and cold-storage infrastructure demands.
  • Flexible formulation: Easily adapts across foodservice, snack processing, baking, instant meals, and private-label retail applications.
  • Scalable procurement: Available in versatile wholesale and export quantities with packaging formats matching diverse business sizes.

Quality, Documentation, and Compliance

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. Our quality approach centers on careful raw material selection, moisture control, hygienic processing, clear batch identification and written product specifications. We follow standard operating procedures at each stage of production. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. For each shipment we provide batch details, allergen declarations, the packing list, commercial invoice, certificate of origin and other export paperwork as needed. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Any buyer-specific standards can be reviewed during quotation.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Our standard packaging is designed to protect the powder against humidity, environmental contamination, light exposure, and physical damage throughout storage and transit. Available formats range from small commercial packs and foodservice containers to wholesale bags and export-ready bulk packaging. Private label and custom printed packaging can also be arranged. Shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when stored in appropriate moisture-barrier packaging under recommended warehousing environments. Exact expiration timeframes are stamped on batch labels and accompanying documentation. Store goods in a cool, dry, and clean environment away from direct sunlight, excessive heat, potent odors, pests, and moisture. Keep packages tightly sealed after opening and utilize clean, dry utensils for handling.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotations

The minimum order quantity for our dehydrated potato powder is 5 Kg. This makes it easy to order a trial lot and test the powder in your own recipes. Samples are available on request. Private label runs, custom formulations and printed packaging need extra planning time. Lead time is confirmed with each quotation, after specification sign-off, commercial confirmation and artwork approval. It depends on stock, production scheduling, order volume, labeling and export documents. To initiate a sample request or price quotation, please provide your target volume, preferred mesh size, application type, packaging size, destination country, necessary documentation, and delivery terms. Our team will reply with availability, pricing, sample details and a supply plan.

Why Work with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals, based in Surat, India, supplies dehydrated ingredients and food manufacturing support to B2B clients in India and abroad. We support wholesale procurement, OEM manufacturing, private-label packing, custom formulation design, and targeted ingredient development. We combine practical food know-how with clear commercial support, helping buyers check product fit, choose packaging and set up regular supply. Whether you are evaluating competitive dehydrated potato powder pricing, developing an innovative instant-food formulation, sourcing for a multi-unit restaurant group, or looking for a bulk dehydrated potato powder supplier from India, we offer transparent communication and service built around clear specifications. Submit a quotation request today for our standard potato powder 80 mesh or consult with our team regarding custom requirements for your industrial food application.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Private label runs and custom specifications are reviewed case by case.

What quality documents do you provide?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI licensed and IEC registered. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Export documents are confirmed for each order.

What packaging and shelf-life options are available?

Available options include 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, 25 kg bags, bulk containers, HDPE drums, PET jars, stand-up pouches, private-label retail packs, and secure export packaging. Shelf life is 12 months when properly packaged and stored.

What are the typical technical specifications?

The powder is dehydrated and milled to 80 mesh, with moisture ≤ 8% and a shelf life of 12 months, as stated on the product specification sheet.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Forward your required volume, intended application, mesh size preference, packaging format, shipping destination, and documentation requirements directly to Tradenest Naturals. Our team will review your specifications and reply with availability, pricing details, lead times, and sample dispatch instructions.
